full_page.content:
1911
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 6 Cont.
June 6th Started out in rain for Brother's first holy Mass at 6:15 A.M. - In Buffalo 8 P.M.
7th H. Mass. in Toledo O with Jesuit's. Supper in Chicago with Franc's (Franciscans)
8th Holy Mass in old St. Patrick's Hudson, Wis. after absence of 22 years. - Supper in New Richmond - bed in St. Paul.
9th At S. Paul Seminary - ordination - was with Franciscans & in new State Building.
10th Via Minneapolis to Superior.
11th Solemn 1st Mass and Vespers, Solemn Mass in Franciscans Church
13 In Duluth & in a real Bridge
18th Exhorted at Solemn Mass to frequent Communion and grate- fully to pray for Rt. Rev. Fr. Fardy
19th Bade Good Bye to BR and Friends ,
20th In Ashland and Bayfield - Saw Apostle Isles - really grand.
21st Through Green Bay etc, to Milwaukee - Mass on St. Aloysius Altar, P.M. At Commencement in old seminary Hall. - Met old professors and class-mates
26th Left Milwaukee for Chicago.
26-28 In Chicago at Catholic Educational Convention
29th With Franciscan Fathers in Buffalo 3 hours.
